subject: [hw] DONE V19 rev 2 (F10 VSRI/VSLI fixed)
body:
V19 rev 2: R1 finding F10 (VSRI/VSLI kept the wrong half of the destination) is fixed. Host-tested only; no phone, no publish.

Last lines of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v19/run_tests.sh:
    gen_vectors: 495 encodings, 3960 vectors
    sweep: 52640 OK, 147360 UNDEF, 200000 total
    N2TEST V19 PASS 44435/44435
(ASan+UBSan -O1 and plain -O2, identical summary.)

Changes since DONE rev 1 (F10 only, no interface change):
- n2a32_neon_shift.c vsri/vsli: VSRI now keeps the destination's most significant shift' bits and inserts src>>shift into the low bits; VSLI keeps the destination's least significant shift' bits and inserts src<<shift into the high bits; VSLI #0 is the source. The old code had the halves swapped.
- gen_vectors.py vsri/vsli model corrected the same way, so the 3960-vector suite tests the architecture, not the implementation.
- Hand cases added with Vd=deadbeef and the R1 repros: vsri.32 q0,q1,#8 = f3b80452 -> ff112233 / de112233; vsli.32 q0,q1,#8 = f3a80552 -> 223344ff / 223344ef. Note for R1: their VSLI repro used f2a80552, which is VSHL.I32 (U=0); the VSLI encoding is f3a80552 (U=1).
- STATUS.md updated (VSRI/VSLI description, F10 note, new count).

Everything else from DONE rev 1 stands: VSHR/VSRA/VRSHR/VRSRA, VSRI/VSLI, VSHL imm, VQSHL/VQSHLU, VSHRN/VRSHRN/VQSHRN/VQRSHRN/VQSHRUN/VQRSHRUN, VSHLL/VMOVL, VCVT fixed<->float; VADDL/VADDW/VSUBL/VSUBW, VADDHN/VRADDHN/VSUBHN/VRSUBHN, VABAL/VABDL, VMLAL/VMLSL, VQDMLAL/VQDMLSL, VMULL/VMULL.P8, VQDMULL; scalar VMLA/VMLS/VMUL int+float, VMLAL/VMLSL/VMULL/VQDMLAL/VQDMLSL/VQDMULL/VQDMULH/VQRDMULH. QC in FPSCR bit 27; NEON float round-to-nearest/default NaN/flush-to-zero.

Not done / open (unchanged except the differential note):
- No phone/hardware run; VCVT fixed rounding is the ARM ARM FPToFixed(...,round_to_zero=TRUE)/FixedToFP reading, no silicon tie-case check.
- Not compiled for arm64 iOS; needs libm fegetround/fesetround (libSystem has it).
- T01 differential: k19 kernels are in emu/test_v19/k19_neon_shift.c and compile for armv7a NEON. With V18/V20 now in the tree, a local harness run with only the k19 kernels reports 460/1120 differing calls, but the V19 ops reproduce the host hashes for seed 0 (VADDW.U16+VSHRN.I32 2c610a32, VMLAL.S16 d16dae9d); the differences are in the V18/V20 setup. k19_narrow/shift_imm/narrow_sat/scalar_mul pass in the arm/armv8 rows; thumb-O0 stops at T32 32-bit instructions (V15/V16 missing). Reported to T01 with the isolation evidence.
- FPSCR cumulative exception bits are not set by NEON float; only QC.
- Deliberately UNDEF list unchanged (V20 spaces, shift opc 0xb/c/d, VSRI/VQSHLU U=0, VSHLL bit6=1, VCVT fbits outside 1..32, out-of-range narrow shifts, size 3, scalar size 0/3, VQDMLAL/VQDMLSL/VQDMULL size 0 or U=1, VMULL.P8 U=1/size!=0, odd Q register numbers, unallocated holes). Full table in emu/test_v19/STATUS.md.

Files (all new, unchanged paths): gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_neon_shift.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v19/{run_tests.sh,gen_vectors.py,t_v19.c,k19_neon_shift.c,STATUS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V19/STATUS.md. No commit. Available for R1's re-check of F10 and any further findings.
